data.title: General consent for admission and treatment
data.situations: Every admission: at the admission desk, or as soon as the patient or the person deciding for them can sign (MSDS 72).

texts.body:
I agree to be admitted to this hospital and to receive the examinations, tests, nursing care and treatment my doctors consider necessary. An operation, anaesthesia, a blood transfusion or another risky procedure will be explained to me separately and done only with my separate consent.
The need for my admission and the expected length and cost of my stay, written below, were explained to me. I und…

texts.body:

texts.body:

data.form_title: داخلے اور علاج کے لیے عمومی رضامندی
data.form_body:
میں اس ہسپتال میں داخل ہونے اور اپنے ڈاکٹروں کی تجویز کردہ ضروری معائنوں، ٹیسٹوں، نرسنگ نگہداشت اور علاج پر رضامند ہوں۔ کوئی آپریشن، بے ہوشی، خون لگانا یا کوئی اور خطرے والا طبی عمل مجھے الگ سے سمجھایا جائے گا اور میری الگ رضامندی کے بغیر نہیں کیا جائے گا۔
میرے داخلے کی ضرورت، اندازاً قیام کی مدت اور خرچ، جو نیچے درج ہیں، مجھے سمجھا دیے گئے ہیں۔ میں سمجھتا/سمجھتی ہوں کہ یہ اندازے ہیں جو میری حالت …

progress_reporting.when: After each implemented screen, before switching workspace or handoff. Propose only tested items; identify the build and limitations. Do not duplicate unchanged pending/accepted work. Human approval still required.

delivery_gate.rule:
A screen or workspace is unfinished until its working UI, F1 contextual help, English/Urdu screen handbook,
workspace guide and detailed FAQ for every supported role, bounded 100-250% keyboard zoom, frontend coverage checks,
and named human review of fresh, newly created data and supported CRUD operations are complete. Follow the workspace review
checklist (guide 17). Missing evidence stays pending; seeded-demo browsing, API tests or screenshots alone do not
establish completion. Agents propose evidence; only authenticated human review accepts progress.

compulsory.label: F1 contextual help
compulsory.what: F1 opens the correct permitted help, including from fields/dialogs, preserves unsaved work and restores focus. Visible Help also works; login/locked/kiosk help exposes only public/operator guidance.

compulsory.label: Complete role-specific FAQs
compulsory.what: Every supported role task in this workspace, including shared screens and handovers, has a detailed reviewed English/Urdu FAQ. Follow get_handbook_outline; a generic FAQ or an unreviewed role journey is unfinished.

compulsory.label: Keyboard zoom: 100-250% only
compulsory.what: Ctrl++/Ctrl+=, Ctrl+- and Ctrl+0 (Command on macOS), Settings and all enabled zoom routes share one state clamped to 100-250%. Test both bounds, reset, persistence and usable English/Urdu layouts at 250%.

compulsory.label: Human review with newly created data
compulsory.what: A named human follows guide 17 on this build: creates new synthetic records through the UI and verifies read, update/correction and permitted delete/cancel/deactivate paths, refusal paths and handovers. Read-only screens use fresh upstream records. Record IDs and evidence; pre-existing demo data alone is insufficient.

zoom.one_state: The keys, the Settings slider and any menu, wheel or pinch zoom move ONE zoom state, clamped to 100.0-250.0 %, saved as ui_scale_pct (PUT /settings/me) and restored at login (/auth/me preferences). Electron: webContents.setZoomFactor(pct / 100).

delivery_gate.workspace_done_when: Every screen of the workspace has every compulsory item above, in addition to its endpoints, events and rules: F1 contextual Help, a detailed FAQ for every role of the workspace (English and Urdu), the bounded keyboard zoom and a named human's review with newly created data (get_guide('workspace-review-checklist')), signed on the portal. Missing any one, the workspace is NOT done: report it as pending, never as complete.

acceptance_rules: Pre-operative note: history and examination, provisional diagnosis (ICD picker optional), plan, the side to mark; editable until the sign in.

The consent to the operation (part OperationConsent): POST /consents with form_code OPERATION and the booking_id (prefilled with the procedure and the surgeon), in the patient's language; add the risks, benefits and alternatives, print, explain, sign; the sign in needs it (CONSENT_REQUIRED).

Operative note: the first save fills the team, anaesthesia and diagnosis from the record; every part of the post-operative plan is required (offer a 'Not needed' button). Sign when the operation is over, before the patient leaves recovery (OT_OPERATIVE_NOTE_REQUIRED stops the discharge). Signing sets the ward's vitals interval to the plan's monitoring interval.
Every write answers with the whole surgical record: redraw from it. Show `parts` as a strip of steps (Missing grey, Draft amber, Final green, NotNeeded hidden) and `next_step` as the call to action.
A draft lists what signing still needs (`missing`): mark those fields. OT_RECORD_INCOMPLETE carries details.missing too.
Signed parts are read-only (OT_RECORD_FINAL): offer 'Add a correction' (POST /ot/bookings/{booking_id}/corrections with the part, the text and the reason); corrections print under the part.
OT_PRIVILEGE_REQUIRED: the hospital has not authorized this person for this act (clinical privileges); say so and name who may sign. Refresh on ot.clinical.updated.

Exists for the service surgery (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id surgical_record_surgeon (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.
demo_accounts: demo_accounts() lists a login per role; sandbox_call runs each case on the DEV server
